items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 234:1
items.html: The screen of phase two, which serves for the exit of the ten Sefirot in the stature of Ima and is corrected in the Yesod of Ima, is called the feet of Ima. And since Ima clothed in ZON in order to bestow Mochin to Beriah, her aforementioned feet are found touching the Parsa beneath Atzilut, and she was included in it, and because of this the Mochin of Beriah came out in the aspect of Hassadim separated from Hochma. See above, answer 52. (Item 198).
